_comment: Site-wide settings that are not content. Read by scripts/sync-analytics.js and anything else that needs a fact about the site rather than about an entry. Adding a key here is cheaper than adding an env var to five workflows.

analytics._howToFill: Cloudflare dashboard -> Web Analytics -> the thiccctionary.com site -> Manage site. The JS snippet it shows contains data-cf-beacon='{"token": "..."}'. Paste that token string here, commit, and the next pipeline run puts the beacon on every page in the sitemap plus 404.html. Cookieless and privacy-first, so no consent banner is needed. Until this is filled in, scripts/sync-analytics.js does nothing.

verification._comment: Search Console and friends. Each value is the bare content= string from the provider's meta-tag verification method, not the whole tag. Empty means not configured and nothing is injected.
